title: Fast-Meter Refund Limits on Large Power and Medium Demand Schedules, Metering Service
content:
The rate schedule of the Electric Service Agreement decides the limit on the number of bills a **Metering Service** fast-meter refund counts back.

| Electric Service Agreement schedule | Fast-meter refund limit |
|---|---|
| Schedule LP Large Power Service | 3 months, the large-power refund limit |
| Schedule GD Medium General Demand Service | 6 months, the medium-demand refund limit |
| Any other schedule | No large-power or medium-demand limit applies |

**Clause.** Where the agreement is on Schedule LP, the fast-meter refund limit is the large-power refund limit of 3 months. Where the agreement is on Schedule GD, the fast-meter refund limit is the medium-demand refund limit of 6 months.

**Reading the schedule.** The schedule is the one the service agreement is on, as its record shows, not the schedule the meter type could bill.

**Hypothetical cases.** A Primary Metering Installation on an agreement served under Schedule LP Large Power Service has a 3-month limit; an AMI Interval Demand Meter on Schedule GD Medium General Demand Service has a 6-month limit; a Standard AMI Smart Meter on Schedule RS Residential Standard Service has neither.
